full_page.content:
Page 136
Apr. 4 Mrs. Marie Bruder - 47 - cancer feared - operation feared as very dangerous.
4 Mary Buchner - 70 - heart and hemoraging.
Mrs. Margaret Caton - 63 - asthma - finds it hard to breathe Mary Steward - 23 - peculiar paralysis - perfectly healthy till about three years ago; now can walk only with difficulty; falls very easily.
4 James Sworsh - 9 - running and fell on broken glass - blood poison feared.
Apr. 7 See Nov. 18 last - Thanks .. . Philip Disman of Bay City - 44 - steaple painter fell three and half stories, breaking his back and losing over three inches of back bone and below that totally paralyzed. This happened ten yrs ago. He came on crutches last October and was hardly able to drag himself along ... To-day he came all in smiles " .. getting along fine". However, he has to use a cain still and has defective kidnies ....
Page 137
Apr. 2 Alban - 28 - in Service - discouraged. .. . Parents ask for prayers . .. Justus Gies - 29 - nerveous and worrying.
10th Genevieve Karajnta - 50 - stomach - cancer - operation two weeks ago. Drs call it "Hopeless" nothing but prayer . Enrolled To-day. Fred Bell - 58 - congrationist - lung and heart trouble.
11 David Lordy - 6 - Episcopelian - injured at birth - has never been able to sit alone or talk - enrolled To-night.
Louis Schulte - 10443 E. Outer Dr. Pi 4639 - had car stolen. Wife was distributing Easter charities when it was taken.
Mrs. M. Sansone - 50 - had P. Stroke last June - laments as poorly ever since ... five in family.
Dora Bahlinger - 53 - fearful case of arthritis - invalid for over 30 yrs. Last 14 quite so. Just sits in chair all day long. Would like to walk and be able to help herself. ..
